CRLR No. 156 of 2021
Hon’ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
Mr. Ambrish Kumar, learned counsel 
for the appellant.
Mr. Sandeep Tandon, learned 
counsel for the CBI.
Heard the matter through video 
conferencing.
This revision is preferred against the 
order dated 10.02.2021 passed by the 1st
Additional Sessions Judge, Dehradun in 
CBI Case No. 2 of 2020, CBI vs. K.K. 
Singhal. Since, the revision is time 
barred, accordingly, delay condonation 
application has been moved to condone 
the delay.
Learned counsel for the CBI has no 
objection.
Delay condonation application has 
been supported by an affidavit.
Grounds shown are sufficient. 
Accordingly, delay condonation 
application is allowed. Delay is condoned.
Admit.
List the matter on 25.08.2021.
In the meantime, learned counsel 
for the revisionist will submit the 
statement of PW1.
Objection, if any, in the meantime.
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.) 
 22.07.2021
Parul
